messages:
maya: Planning note — webinar on inference economics next Wed. Need a tight bench narrative, two hero soundbites for the landing page, and a simple inbound routing map for leads. Short thread to lock copy and hand to SDRs.
raj: I'll run cost/latency p50 and p95 for chat (2k context) and embeddings (batch 64) against our hosted and dedicated stacks. ETA 4pm. Any guardrails on claims?
tori: I'll add a tail latency test (warm vs cold) and call out cache priming behavior. Will share screenshots.
maya: Keep claims conservative. Use phrasing like "up to" and link to bench appendix.
sam: For SDR routing, propose tag schema: webinar_bench, region, intent. Routing rules:
```
- webinar_bench=true
- region=NA/EU/APAC
- intent=hot/warm/cold
-> hot: AE assign immediate
-> warm: SDR sequence + follow-up
-> cold: nurture drip
```
sam: Can we implement a webhook on the form to emit these tags? @jordan
jordan: Yes. I can add hidden inputs and POST to /webhooks/lead-route. Need final field names and a test payload.
raj: Uploaded artifacts: bench_chat_2k_3501234567.csv and p95_latency_3501234567.png. Numbers look strong but I'll annotate uncertainties.
maya: Hero soundbite candidates: 1) "Production-first controls for latency and unit cost" 2) "Same serving everywhere: hosted -> dedicated -> private" Feedback?
tori: Tighten 1 to "Reduces unit cost and controls latency". Add a qualifier like "under common production workloads."
maya: OK: "Reduces unit cost by up to 50% under common production workloads" — we'll reference the appendix.
raj: Note: quantization and batching assumptions in the appendix. Call out model family and sequence lengths.
launchbot: Reminder scheduled: update landing page copy and add webhook before 09:00 tomorrow.
maya: I'll push a battlecard draft to the doc and tag SDRs for a 10am handoff. If no major edits, ship to field tomorrow. :rocket:
